goal.objective: Reduce GitHub Actions runner minutes while keeping every required CI check enabled and passing.
constraints: Work only in a team-controlled fork.
Do not change the library's application behavior as part of a CI-only optimization.

workflow.raw_yaml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

    - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@319994f95fa847cf3fb3cd3dbe89f6dcde9f178f # v1.295.0
      with:
        ruby-version: "3.4"
        bundler-cache: true

    - run: bundle exec rubocop

  tests:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        ruby:         ["ruby-3.2", "ruby-3.3", "ruby-3.4", "ruby-4.0", "jruby-9.4", "jruby-10.0"]
        activerecord: ["6.1", "7.0", "7.1", "7.2", "8.0", "8.1"]
        postgresql:   ["13", "14", "15", "16", "17", "18"]
        exclude:
          # fails due to "ArgumentError: when initializing an Active Record adapter with a config hash, that should be the only argument" in db:schema:load
          - ruby: "jruby-9.4"
            activerecord: "7.2"
          - ruby: "jruby-9.4"
            activerecord: "8.0"
          # fails due to "Because activerecord >= 8.0.0.beta1 depends on Ruby >= 3.2.0 and Gemfile depends on activerecord ~> 8.1, Ruby >= 3.2.0 is required. So, because current Ruby version is = 3.1.7, version solving has failed."
          - ruby: "jruby-9.4"
            activerecord: "8.1"
          # https://github.com/jruby/activerecord-jdbc-adapter/issues/1173
          - ruby: "jruby-10.0"
            activerecord: "8.0"
          # https://github.com/jruby/activerecord-jdbc-adapter/issues/1184
          - ruby: "jruby-10.0"
            activerecord: "8.1"
    name: "Active Record ${{ matrix.activerecord }} with PostgreSQL ${{ matrix.postgresql }} on ${{ matrix.ruby }}"
    services:
      db:
        image: postgres:${{ matrix.postgresql }}
        env:
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
          POSTGRES_DB: jsonb_accessor
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: --health-cmd pg_isready --health-interval 10s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 5
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

    - run: echo "gem 'activerecord', '~> ${{ matrix.activerecord }}.0'" > Gemfile.local

    - if:  matrix.activerecord == '6.1' # see https://github.com/rails/rails/pull/54264#issuecomment-2596149819 and https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/news/2024/12/25/ruby-3-4-0-released/#standard-library-updates and https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/news/2025/12/25/ruby-4-0-0-released/#stdlib-updates
      run: printf "gem 'concurrent-ruby', '< 1.3.5'\ngem 'mutex_m'\ngem 'base64'\ngem 'bigdecimal'\ngem 'logger'\n" >> Gemfile.local

    - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@319994f95fa847cf3fb3cd3dbe89f6dcde9f178f # v1.295.0
      with:
        ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby }}
        bundler-cache: true

    - run: bundle exec rake db:schema:load

    - run: bundle exec rake spec

required_checks.name: tests
required_checks.command: bundle exec rake db:schema:load && bundle exec rake spec

limits.practical_win_rule: A practical win requires all three matched pairs to reduce required runner minutes and the mean reduction to be at least 5%. This is a project decision rule, not proof of statistical certainty.
limits.uncertainty_method: Report a paired t-based 95% confidence interval for the mean runner-minute reduction alongside all three pair results. With only three pairs, label the interval exploratory; it does not determine the practical win verdict and is not proof of statistical certainty.
limits.confidence_interval_method: Report a paired 95% confidence interval for the mean runner-minute reduction alongside all three pair results. Treat it as exploratory with only three pairs; it does not determine the practical win verdict and must not be described as proof of statistical certainty.
comparison_conditions: Run baseline and candidate on the same workflow revision.
Use the same runner type and dependency/cache conditions for each pair.
Run the full required workflow matrix; do not omit required matrix cells.
Aggregate required_runner_minutes by summing runner minutes across all required jobs and matrix cells.
The experiment time cap measures elapsed wall-clock time, not summed runner minutes.
Keep queue delay separate from runner time.
stop_conditions: Stop if any required check is disabled, removed, or fails.
Stop when the configured attempt, run-pair, or time budget is exhausted.
Stop and request human input when required context or access is missing.
